description: Approved disbursements from the 31 title escrow trust accounts: seller proceeds, loan payoffs, commissions, and fees (about 1,520 outgoing wires per business day, about $136 million a day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same-day funding expected by lenders, sellers, and buyers moving in; afternoon bank wire cutoffs; payoff per diem interest; trust funds may move only under the closing instructions (Fla. Stat. 626.8473(4), Florida worked example)
manual_workaround: Bank online portals with dual approval and hardware tokens for urgent wires (about 150 a day can be keyed manually); non-urgent disbursements move to the next morning
dependent_third_parties: 5 trust banks; title production platform vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Escrow accounting and disbursement team (about 120); 140 closing offices
quantified_impact_basis: Per diem payoff interest, extension and rescheduling costs, and goodwill credits on about 350 closings a day (about $8,900 each); funds are delayed, not lost
acquired_firm_dependency: AQ-09 disburses from its own trust accounts in its legacy closing software
single_points_of_failure: Disbursement Hub (one active region with warm standby); bank account ownership verification provider

description: Closing disclosures and settlement statements, document packages, signing appointments, and recording for about 350 closings per business day
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Closings are scheduled to the hour; a missed day pushes rate locks, moving trucks, and lease ends; lender closing instructions
manual_workaround: Closing packages printed the day before; signings rescheduled; manual settlement statements for same-day closings from read-only exports
dependent_third_parties: Title production platform vendor; e-signature service; county recording portals
quantified_impact_basis: About $1.64 million of Title and Escrow revenue per business day deferred, plus about $0.3 million overtime and rescheduling (included)
acquired_firm_dependency: AQ-09 closings run in SYS-02L (see BP-18)

business_process: Closing communications and wire instruction delivery
description: Secure delivery of wire instructions, closing documents, and payoff requests to buyers, sellers, lenders, and agents through the Closing Communications Hub, including identity and payee bank account verification
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: An outage pushes parties back to email and phone, which is the gap fraudsters exploit (P01 R-001, R-002); payee verification results must not be lost
manual_workaround: Phone-only confirmation of instructions read from SYS-02 by a second closer; no instructions sent by email under any circumstances (POL-04 4.9)
dependent_third_parties: Bank account ownership verification provider; identity verification provider; messaging service
quantified_impact_basis: Extra closer time for phone confirmations and higher fraud exposure; estimated from the 6-hour portal outage in 2025
acquired_firm_dependency: AQ-09 does not use the Hub
single_points_of_failure: Identity verification provider; bank account ownership verification provider

description: Request, receive, and verify payoff statements for existing mortgages and liens; confirm payee accounts with lenders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payoffs must be verified before disbursement; spoofed payoff letters are the second most common diversion path (P01 R-002)
manual_workaround: Request payoffs through lender portals or by phone to the lender's published number; hold disbursement until verified
dependent_third_parties: Lender payoff portals; payoff aggregation service
quantified_impact_basis: Delayed closings that depend on unverified payoffs (about 8% of daily closings)
single_points_of_failure: Payoff aggregation service for about 60% of lenders

description: Contracts, addenda, compliance review, document storage, and deadline tracking for about 840 transaction sides per business day on the transaction management platform
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract deadlines (inspection, financing, appraisal) run in days; brokers must keep transaction records; about $15.7 million of gross commission income per business day depends on timely closings
manual_workaround: Agents keep working from copies of contracts in email; coordinators track deadlines from the daily export; compliance review catches up after restoration
dependent_third_parties: Transaction management platform vendor; e-signature service
quantified_impact_basis: About 3% of closings slip a day (about $0.5 million of deferred commission) plus extension fees, coordinator overtime, and agent attrition risk; a vendor outage beyond 3 days risks lost deals
acquired_firm_dependency: AQ-06 to AQ-08 agents use SYS-01 with legacy email identities
single_points_of_failure: Transaction management platform (100% of brokerage transactions; contract RTO 24 hours)

business_process: Earnest money deposit receipt and escrow accounting
description: Receipt, deposit, and reconciliation of about 44,000 earnest money deposits a year in the brokerage sales escrow accounts; deposit verification follow-up where others hold the deposit
process_owner: Florida Broker of Record (with each state's broker of record)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Florida worked example: deposits must be placed in escrow by the end of the third business day (r. 61J2-14.008(3)) and reconciled monthly (r. 61J2-14.012(2)); other states set their own deadlines
manual_workaround: Deposits made at bank branches or by remote deposit with paper logs; reconciliation after restoration
quantified_impact_basis: Regulatory exposure for late deposits and staff overtime; deposits are delayed, not lost
acquired_firm_dependency: AQ-06 to AQ-08 use their own escrow ledgers until migration

business_process: Closing operations at AQ-09 (legacy closing software)
description: Closings and disbursements at the acquired Texas title agency, still on its own closing software and trust accounts (about 9% of Title and Escrow's Texas closings)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same drivers as BP-04 and BP-05; the legacy software is backed up nightly, so the real RPO is 24 hours against the 15-minute target
manual_workaround: Urgent closings handed to the enterprise Texas closing offices on SYS-02
dependent_systems: SYS-02L (legacy closing software on a hosted server); AQ-09 legacy email
quantified_impact_basis: About 20 closings a day deferred plus overtime
single_points_of_failure: Legacy closing software on one hosted server with nightly backup only

business_process: Title search, commitment, and policy issuance
description: Title searches, commitments, curative work, and policy issuance for about 88,000 closings a year
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Searches are ordered weeks ahead of closing; a 2-day outage can be absorbed by working the backlog
manual_workaround: Title plant searches through county portals; commitments issued after restoration
dependent_third_parties: Title production platform vendor; title plant data providers; title insurance underwriters
quantified_impact_basis: Backlog overtime and a share of deferred closings beyond 48 hours

business_process: Listing management and consumer website and app
description: Listing entry, MLS syndication, consumer property search, saved searches, and inquiry capture
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Consumer and agent expectations; MLS rules on listing accuracy; inquiries are lost while down
manual_workaround: MLS systems still show listings; agents take inquiries by phone
dependent_third_parties: MLS data feeds; content delivery network
quantified_impact_basis: Lost and delayed leads (about 1,900 inquiries a day) valued at expected commission

description: Routing inquiries to agents, buyer lead scoring, and follow-up tasks in the CRM
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Speed to first contact drives conversion; fair housing rules require equal service (P10 AI-002)
manual_workaround: Round-robin routing by spreadsheet in each region

description: Rent collection (about $48 million a month), late notices, and monthly ACH owner distributions for about 21,000 homes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Rent posts in the first days of the month; owner distributions are due by contract on set days; trust accounting rules in each state
manual_workaround: Checks and money orders accepted at regional offices and posted after restoration; distributions paid a few days late with notice
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor and its payment processor; banks
quantified_impact_basis: Late distribution penalties under owner agreements and accounting overtime

description: Rental applications, tenant screening, and lease signing for about 64,000 applications a year
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Vacancy days cost owners rent; screening decisions must follow written criteria and FCRA notices (P10 AI-001)
manual_workaround: Paper applications held until the platform returns; no manual screening shortcuts
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor; tenant screening provider
quantified_impact_basis: Vacancy cost on delayed move-ins (about 250 applications a day)
regulatory_driver: N53-R02 (45(a)); N53-R03 (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, ADMT)

description: Tenant maintenance requests and emergency dispatch of vendors (water leaks, no heat or cooling, lockouts)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Habitability and tenant safety; emergency calls cannot wait a day
manual_workaround: 24x7 phone line answered by the after-hours call center; dispatch from printed vendor lists
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor; maintenance vendors; telephony carrier
quantified_impact_basis: Emergency vendor premiums and damage from slower response

description: Move management, home-sale program administration, and expense processing for about 16,000 relocating employees of about 280 corporate clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client contracts set service levels; relocating employees are mid-move; client SOC 2 expectations (P09)
manual_workaround: Client managers serve by phone and email from the last exported files; expense payments delayed
dependent_third_parties: Relocation management platform vendor; moving and household goods partners
quantified_impact_basis: Service-level credits and client attrition risk

description: Commission calculation from closed transactions and payouts to about 38,000 agents
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Agents expect payment within days of closing; payout bank account changes are a fraud target (P01 R-055)
manual_workaround: Pay from the prior-day file; manual calculations for disputes
dependent_third_parties: ERP and commission platform vendor; banks
acquired_firm_dependency: AQ-06 to AQ-08 pay agents from their own systems until migration

mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pay dates and wage payment laws in 9 states
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll with adjustments afterward
quantified_impact_basis: Penalties and adjustment cost if a pay date is missed

description: Monthly and quarterly close, consolidation, and SEC filings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines; at quarter-end the MTD drops to 48 hours
manual_workaround: Extended close calendar; prior-day ledger extracts
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and outside advisor cost; a missed SEC deadline is a Severe regulatory impact

business_process: Agent onboarding, licensing compliance, and offboarding
description: License verification, onboarding to systems, and removal of access when agents leave (about 9,800 joins and 9,100 departures a year)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Onboarding can wait; offboarding delays leave access in departed agents' hands (P01 R-012)
manual_workaround: Managing brokers request disablement through the service desk by phone
acquired_firm_dependency: AQ-06 to AQ-08 onboard agents in legacy tenants
